game.title: Need for Speed Payback
game.blurb: Open-world street racing game set in Fortune Valley, from Ghost Games, released 2017-11-07. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Racing, Arcade. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The crew's story in Fortune Valley and its racing leagues. Spoiler-guarded; these achievements are hidden.

chapters.title: Open-World Activities and Roaming Racers
chapters.summary: Speed Traps, Speed Runs, Drift Zones, Jumps, Billboards, 3-star ratings and the Roaming Racer bosses.

chapters.title: Cars, Derelicts and Tuning
chapters.summary: REP levels, Derelict cars, garages, Speed Cards, brand setups and visual customisation.

chapters.title: Speedcross
chapters.summary: Speedcross cars from the dealership, upgrades and the Fortune Valley Speedcross Series.

chapters.title: Featured Car Challenges
chapters.summary: Owning and driving the cover cars, the BMW M5 drift trial and the Nissan GT-R against the 1% Club.

chapters.title: Online and Challenges
chapters.summary: Speedlists, Ranked Speedlists, Autolog Recommendations and Daily Challenges.

chapters.title: Racing Feats
chapters.summary: Comebacks, perfect shifts, damage-free wins and taking down pursuit vehicles.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for this game (API returned missing for "Need for Speed Payback" and for "Need for Speed: Payback"). nfs.fandom.com gave no page under "Need for Speed Payback"; needforspeed.fandom.com answers the API under "Need for Speed: Payback", with about 194 linked pages, mostly cars and other series entries, plus "Fortune Valley"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app is 1262580 (the only match in the store list). 20 of 57 Steam achievements are hidden; 17 of them (1 to 17) are probably story beats and crew rivals, and sit in the main story chapter. Three hidden ones further down ("All In", "Hyperspeed", "Pranked") also sit there as a placeholder, though they may be side goals. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
